aogPerils.details: Large hailstones (>25mm) cause micro-cracks and cell fractures in modules

aogPerils.mitigation: Elevated mounting structures, proper drainage, site selection above HFL
aogPerils.details: Ground-mount inverters and transformers vulnerable to water damage

aogPerils.mitigation: SPD installation, proper earthing, lightning protection system (LPS)
aogPerils.details: Surge damage to inverters, monitoring systems, and module junction boxes

aogPerils.mitigation: Wind-rated structures (>180 km/h), module clamp reinforcement
aogPerils.details: Coastal projects in AP/TN/Odisha face cyclone risk; structural failure of mounting

nonAogPerils.mitigation: Preventive maintenance, spare inventory, remote monitoring
nonAogPerils.details: String/central inverters: IGBT failures, capacitor degradation, fan failures

nonAogPerils.mitigation: Anti-PID modules, proper grounding, I-V curve testing
nonAogPerils.details: Potential Induced Degradation causes 30-80% power loss in affected modules

nonAogPerils.mitigation: Oil analysis, thermography, protection relays, spare transformer policy
nonAogPerils.details: Pooling transformer failure causes entire block outage; 6-month lead time for replacement

nonAogPerils.mitigation: Proper cable management, thermal rating compliance, termite-proof conduits
nonAogPerils.details: DC cable fires due to loose connections; rodent/termite damage to underground cables

emergingRisks.description: Lithium-ion battery systems co-located with solar can experience thermal runaway, cascading cell failures
emergingRisks.insurance: Standalone BESS Fire Cover, CAR extension

Mooring/anchor systems failure in reservoirs due to water level fluctuations
Combined agricultural activity beneath elevated solar panels creating unexpected structural loads
emergingRisks.insurance: Extended EAR cover for agri-voltaic projects

bestPractices.benefit: Detect hotspots, bypass diodes failure, string faults across large arrays
Identify module degradation, PID, mismatch losses early
Prevent tracking errors causing 5-15% generation loss
Modules tested to 45mm hail at 30 m/s reduce claims by 60%

caseStudies.title: Rajasthan Hailstorm — 500 MW Plant
caseStudies.description: Massive hailstorm damaged 180,000 modules in Bhadla region. Claim settled under MD policy. Key learning: Module selection and tracker tilt protocols critical.
caseStudies.learning: Deploy hail-resistant modules in hail-prone belts; install weather alert systems for auto-tilt

caseStudies.title: AP Cyclone Damage — 200 MW Solar
caseStudies.description: Cyclone Mandous caused structural failure of fixed-tilt mounting in coastal AP. Module tables flew off foundations.
caseStudies.learning: Coastal projects need cyclone-rated structures (>200 km/h); anchor bolt torque verification critical

caseStudies.title: Tamil Nadu Lightning Surge
caseStudies.description: Multiple lightning strikes during monsoon damaged 45 string inverters and monitoring systems across 150 MW plant.
caseStudies.learning: Comprehensive SPD installation at every distribution board; proper earthing mesh essential
